name: popImapSignInAccountCount
definition: The number of accounts with at least one successful POP or IMAP sign-in in the identity provider's sign-in log over the last 30 days; 0 only from a complete read.
population: the accounts that appear in the tenant's Microsoft Entra ID interactive sign-in log for the last 30 days with clientAppUsed POP or IMAP; the value is the number of those accounts with at least one sign-in whose status.errorCode is 0
evidenceRequiredForTrue: A complete read (every page, no truncation marker, no next link left) of the tenant's sign-in log filtered to POP and IMAP for the last 30 days, every returned sign-in carrying a readable status.errorCode, with none of them successful; a refused, unlicensed or partial read is not evidence.
citations: Microsoft Graph v1.0 List signIns (permission AuditLog.Read.All): https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/signin-list (doc-verified, not live-verified)
Microsoft Graph v1.0 signIn resource (clientAppUsed, status; Entra ID P1 or P2 licence needed): https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/resources/signin (doc-verified, not live-verified)

changeLog.change: Registered so the Entra POP and IMAP sign-in transform can emit it (tracker row 61). Kept off every requirement.

notes: Names the accounts that used POP or IMAP. An empty population from a complete read means no account used POP or IMAP, which is the compliant state. Interactive sign-ins only; per-mailbox POP and IMAP enabled state is not read.
